text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United Nations envoy arrives in Cyprus in mid-week without bringing anything specific on Cyprus problem.
- President Glafcos Clerides calls for unity among Greek Cypriots as he lays a foundation stone at the memorial statue of General George Grivas, leader of the EOKA movement.
- Theatre of the absurd. President Clerides, his right wing government and EOKA B erect a memorial for the man who betrayed Cyprus.
- Cyprus's National Council decides today whether it will re-position itself on the conditions for dialogue with the Turkish Cypriots.
- U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright describes the Cyprus problem a "headache" of U.S. foreign policy.
- Events honouring the memory of George Grivas Dhigenis whips up storm of protest among parties. Communist Akel, socialist Edek and centre Free Democrats demand resignation of government.
